# zin_development_learn: one point of learning; every `step` points lift the tier by one (the scholarship technologies and the decisions call it).

zin_development_apply = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_development_learned = yes }
		set_variable = { zin_dev_advanced_cost = constant:zin_development.learned_cost }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { zin_development_settled = yes }
		set_variable = { zin_dev_advanced_cost = constant:zin_development.settled_cost }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { zin_development_customary = yes }
		set_variable = { zin_dev_advanced_cost = constant:zin_development.customary_cost }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_development } }
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_development }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

zin_development_learn = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_dev_tier > 1 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_dev_progress = constant:zin_development.learn_points }
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_development_learn_tt
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dev_step = constant:zin_development.step }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = zin_dev_progress value = zin_dev_step compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { zin_dev_progress = zin_dev_step }
			subtract_from_variable = { zin_dev_tier = 1 }
			zin_development_apply = yes
			custom_effect_tooltip = zin_development_rise_tt
		}
	}
}
